visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young women stand in a studio, facing the camera. The woman in the foreground wears a black sleeveless qipao with gold embroidery; she has dark hair tied in a bun with red lipstick. To her left, a woman in a light pink qipao waves at the camera. Behind them, a woman in a red floral qipao smiles. The setting is an indoor studio with professional lighting gear, a black softbox, and white walls. (2) A medium shot features the woman in the black qipao standing alone in a brightly lit room. She wears a high-collared black qipao with red and gold patterns. She crosses her arms over her chest and maintains a serious, slightly annoyed facial expression while looking directly at the lens. The background contains a white shelf with a blue polaroid camera and a white floor lamp. (3) The shot cuts to the woman in the pink qipao sitting on a plush beige sofa. She has long, reddish-brown hair and smiles warmly. She performs a sequence of hand gestures, holding up one finger, then two, then three, and finally forming a heart shape with her fingers. A framed minimalist painting hangs on the wall behind her in the softly lit living room area. (4) The woman in the red floral qipao appears in a studio corner. She is standing next to a deep red velvet curtain and a black light stand. She grips the pole and moves her body energetically, laughing and making exaggerated facial expressions. She ends the phase by making a playful crying gesture, rubbing her eyes with her fists while still smiling. (5) A final close-up of the woman in red floral qipao continues her playful movement, gesturing towards the camera with high energy as the scene concludes.
